## C3 — The Giving [NEW — glyph, not table]

The positions presented as an inscription before any analysis: six columns, large numerals, no borders, no extra registers. Each column carries the numeral, the core name, the P-statement and the P′-question:

```
     0              1               2              3              4               5
  GROUND        DEFINITION      OPERATION       PATTERN        CONTEXT      QUINTESSENCE
   Why.           What.           How.            Who.          Where.        Why-for.
   Why?           What?           How?            Who?          Where?        Why-for?
```

One line beneath the glyph:

> Six stations, each with a day face and a night face. The statement is the prospective stride; the question is the retrospective turn. Everything else on this page unpacks these twelve.

*(Implementation: a styled strip component — display-font numerals, mono labels, the "." row in white, the "?" row in mist — reading as glyph, not data.)*
